'''Malyas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Believers]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping [[Sith cult|cult]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Malyas was attacked and defeated at a [[Coruscant Believers base|secret Believer hideout]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of spacers]].

==Biography==
Malyas was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and served the [[Believers]],<ref name="CD" /> a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping [[Sith cult|cult]]<ref name="BOTB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> active in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="CD" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is placed in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the events of ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' can be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> the Believers enacted a scheme to seize the [[Pulas]], a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that had been uncovered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Malyas was among a group of Believers who gathered in a [[Coruscant Believers base|secret hideout]] within the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the capture by the cultists of a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box which the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] suspected contained the Pulas. In truth, the box was a decoy and instead contained a fragment of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-imbued [[City/Legends|city]] [[Conkesta]].<ref name="CD" />

{{RPG|''[[Coruscani Dawn]]''}}
A [[Heroes of Cularin|team of spacers]] arrived at the Believer base in pursuit of the stolen artifact. In the resulting altercation, Malyas and the other cultists were defeated and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] box was recovered from the Believers' clutches.<ref name="CD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Skills and abilities==
Malyas was a proficient fighter and combat situations he would move stealthily to ambush his adversaries.<ref name="CD" />

==Equipment==
While at the Believer hideout in the Coruscant undercity, Malyas wore street [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]]. He was armed with a [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]] and a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malyas appeared in ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. In the adventure, the players roleplay as the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who fight Malyas while in pursuit of the stolen Mandalorian iron box. If player characters fail to apprehend a Believer who is keeping guard at the entrance to the cultists' base, Malyas and the other Believers ready themselves to fight and prepare an ambush for when the spacers arrive. Otherwise, when the player characters arrive at the hideout, Malyas is just milling about in the base and is taken by surprise by the spacers' arrival. Following either eventuality, it is possible for Malyas to be incapacitated or [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the player characters in the subsequent battle.<ref name="CD" />

Though Malyas is depicted in ''Coruscani Dawn'' as a member of the Believers, a cult devoted to the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the adventure does not clarify whether he is a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]]. He is provided with roleplaying statistics in the adventure and these do not indicate that he was proficient with any [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]].<ref name="CD" />
